description: This file defines a readonly struct 'SystemTargetGrainId' within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It provides functionality for creating, parsing, and manipulating identifiers for system targets in Orleans, including methods for serialization, comparison, and extracting silo addresses.

classes.name: SystemTargetGrainId
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a system target grain identifier, with methods for creation, comparison, parsing, and address management.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new SystemTargetGrainId based on grain type and silo address.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new SystemTargetGrainId with extra identifier for a given grain type, address, and optional extra identifier string.

methods.name: IsSystemTargetGrainId
methods.description: Checks whether a given GrainId is a system target grain id.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId into a SystemTargetGrainId, returning success status.

methods.name: WithSiloAddress
methods.description: Returns a new SystemTargetGrainId targeting the provided silo address.

methods.name: GetSiloAddress
methods.description: Extracts the SiloAddress from the SystemTargetGrainId.

methods.name: CreateGrainServiceGrainId
methods.description: Creates a GrainId for a grain service with specified type code, system id, and address.

methods.name: CreateGrainType
methods.description: Creates a GrainType representing a specific system target name.
